fusions.name: Upthrust Shelf
fusions.desc: Thrusts a shelf of old reef limestone up through the ground 4 tiles ahead of you, dealing 28 rock damage that ignores armour to everything in it and leaving them [Slowed] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Set in Stone
fusions.desc: A blow with fossil reef that deals 16 rock damage and turns your afflictions on the target to stone: it uses up every one and deals 70% more damage for each. The target is 10% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Limestone Rind
fusions.desc: Raises your armour by 30% for 10 seconds, and your rock resistance by 10%.

fusions.name: Bedrock Reply
fusions.desc: When you take damage that is not fire, you gain a shield worth 12% of your maximum health for 4 seconds. Once every 12 seconds. You have 6% rock resistance.
